Description
This is the original Suzuki Samurai A/C Installation Manual that was used by the Dealers for installation of the A/C System.
This is the complete 38 page installation guide for Samurai™s from 1992-1995.
I don™t have the other years but they are very much the same installation.
This will be sent to your Email account in the form of a PDF file.
It can also be printed and mailed to you.
There is an additional charge of $8 for this delivery method.
It can be paid via an invoice that will be sent to your PayPal Account.
Condition: NEW
Fits: (see note below)
Suzuki Samurai
1992 – 1995 with 4 Cylinder, 1.3L, 8 Valve – Engine
All models
Note
There are many variations of each part within the years and models listed above. Due to this, there is no way to guarantee that the part listed in this ad will be a specific match for the part you are replacing. It is the buyers responsibility to carefully read the item description, thoroughly examine all attached photographs and ask the seller for any additional information that may be needed in order for the buyer to determine that the listed item matches their specific needs. For purposes of œReturns” the part listed in this ad will be considered to have been listed for œFitment correctly if it can be installed in a vehicle that fits any combination of the three groups (Years, Models, Mechanical) listed above. For returned items that meet the aforementioned criteria the Buyer will be charged a 20% restocking fee and bear the cost of the return postage regardless whether the this item is a match to the Buyers item and/or does not meet the Fitment expectations of the Buyer.
